legal_units.title: Charge of tax in case of oral trust.
legal_units.text: Where a trustee receives or is entitled to receive any income on behalf or for the benefit of any person under an oral trust, then, irrespective of anything contained in any other provision of this Act, tax shall be charged on such income at the maximum marginal rate.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XVII SPECIAL PROVISIONS RELATING TO CERTAIN PERSONS Chapter XVII, Division A Association of persons, firm, Hindu undivided family, etc. Chapter XVII, Division A, Subdivision 3 Representative assessees—Special cases Section 308 Charge of tax in case of oral trust. Section 308(1): Where a trustee receives or is entitled to receive any income on behalf or for the benefit of any person under an oral trust, then, irrespective of anything contained in any other provision of this Act, tax shall be charged on such income at the maximum marginal rate.
